name: PC and Network
description: Windows CPU, GPU, memory, storage, adapters and network name lookups

settings.label: Refresh interval
settings.help: Each refresh samples counters for one second. Completion-based polling avoids overlap and catch-up bursts.

settings.label: Resolve local hostnames
settings.help: Try reverse DNS for up to two existing private IPv4 neighbor-cache entries per refresh. Missing names remain unavailable; this is not an exhaustive device inventory.

actions.name: Refresh PC status
actions.description: Sample local Windows counters and try bounded cached-neighbor hostname resolution.

actions.name: Look up name or address
actions.description: Use the system resolver for a hostname, or reverse DNS for one IP address.

parameters.label: Hostname or IP address
parameters.help: A hostname such as printer.local, or an IP address. Do not enter a URL, port, command or subnet.

events.name: PC status updated
events.description: A successful local status sample. Task conditions trigger when a declared numeric comparison becomes true.

events.name: Network lookup completed
events.description: One requested lookup finished with an explicit resolution status.
